name: grid402-mcp
description: Official Grid402 MCP Server - Verifiable Data and HTTP x402 Payment Layer for Autonomous AI Agents across Base, Arbitrum, Polygon, Optimism, Ethereum and Solana (25 tools with ECDSA secp256k1 Oracle Proof).
instructions: Use free tools first (grid402_summary, grid402_pass_balance, grid402_verify). Prefer composite bundles (grid402_get_dossier_360, grid402_domain_audit, grid402_kyb_audit, grid402_market_snapshot) to minimize cost and roundtrips. Set GRID402_SANDBOX=true (X-Payment: demo, 5 req/hour/IP) for testing, GRID402_SESSION_PASS for sub-15ms prepaid calls, or GRID402_PRIVATE_KEY with a low-balance operational Base wallet for automatic x402 settlement.

tools.name: grid402_summary
tools.description: Checks operational health, 30-day uptime and service status across all 23 Grid402 microservices (free, no x402 charge).

tools.name: grid402_forex
tools.description: Queries official real-time FX rates for USD, EUR and GBP against BRL with daily change (0.0050 USDC / 1 credit).

tools.name: grid402_crypto
tools.description: Queries real-time spot prices for BTC, ETH, SOL, USDC and BASE in USD and BRL (0.0050 USDC / 1 credit).

tools.name: grid402_dns
tools.description: Resolves authoritative DNS records (A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS, CNAME) for any domain (0.0050 USDC / 1 credit).

tools.name: grid402_ssl
tools.description: Inspects port 443 TLS/SSL certificates, issuer, SANs, cipher suite and remaining days (0.0050 USDC / 1 credit).

host.description: Hostname or IP address for TLS audit (e.g., base.org)

tools.name: grid402_asn
tools.description: Resolves BGP routing intelligence, ASN number, CIDR allocation block and country for an IP (0.0050 USDC / 1 credit).

tools.name: grid402_domain_audit
tools.description: Composite single-call domain infrastructure bundle: authoritative DNS + TLS/SSL + BGP/ASN with risk score (0.0150 USDC / 3 credits).

domain.description: Target domain for full audit (e.g., base.org)

tools.name: grid402_kyb_audit
tools.description: Composite single-call global KYB audit: Receita Federal CNPJ + OFAC/UN Sanctions + GLEIF LEI (0.0200 USDC / 4 credits).

tools.name: grid402_get_dossier_360

cnpj.description: 14-digit Brazilian CNPJ (with or without mask, e.g., 00000000000191)

tools.name: grid402_market_snapshot

tools.name: grid402_cep

tools.name: grid402_cnpj

tools.name: grid402_indicators

tools.name: grid402_holidays

tools.name: grid402_sanctions

tools.name: grid402_pass

tools.name: grid402_pass_balance

token.description: Session Pass token pass_g402_... (or uses GRID402_SESSION_PASS)

tools.name: grid402_verify
tools.description: Stateless mathematical verification of Grid402 ECDSA secp256k1 oracle signature (_oracle_proof) on any response (free).

payload.description: Serialized JSON response containing the _oracle_proof block
